nodes.text: The Fraud Risk Team is authorized to take into custody of all relevant records, documents, and other evidence related to the relevant investigation to protect them from being stolen, tampered, destroy
nodes.mandatory_action: The Fraud Risk Team must take custody of all relevant records and evidence during investigations.

nodes.text: The full records of the investigation, including interview notes, must be kept under secured access with investigator till the completion of the investigation.
nodes.mandatory_action: Investigation records and interview notes must be secured until the investigation is complete.

nodes.text: The investigations must be kept as confidential and private as possible to ensure the least amount of disruption to the Organization and always maintain the process integrity.
nodes.mandatory_action: Investigations must be conducted confidentially to minimize disruption and maintain integrity.

nodes.text: Confidential information will be shared only on a "need-to-know" basis with required approval.

nodes.text: The Fraud Risk Team must initiate and take necessary actions including but not limited to approaching Law Enforcement Agencies after approval from competent authority whenever appropriate
nodes.mandatory_action: The Fraud Risk Team must take necessary actions after obtaining approval from the competent authority.

nodes.text: A fraud investigation report is required to get an understanding of the fraud investigator’s specific activities, findings, conclusion, and recommendations.
nodes.mandatory_action: A fraud investigation report must be created to document the investigation activities and findings.

nodes.text: The conclusion and results of the investigations must be duly documented in writing.
nodes.mandatory_action: Investigations must be documented in writing.

nodes.mandatory_action: The report must include specified sections: Background, Scope, Approach, and Findings.

nodes.text: Fraud investigator shall be responsible for preparing and owning the fraud examination report.
nodes.mandatory_action: The fraud investigator must prepare and own the fraud examination report.

nodes.text: Physical/original Investigation report shall store with the Centralized repository for future requirement.
nodes.mandatory_action: The original investigation report must be stored in a centralized repository.

nodes.text: Share the investigation and RCA findings with Analytics team to do further analysis and do proactive identification of any such fraud trends.
nodes.mandatory_action: Investigation and RCA findings must be shared with the Analytics team.

nodes.text: Suggest Process Improvement, which is proactive task of identifying.
nodes.mandatory_action: Process improvements must be suggested as a proactive task.

nodes.text: Conduct detailed investigation of the incident
nodes.mandatory_action: Investigate any alleged or suspected incident of fraud in detail.

nodes.text: Obtain/procure evidence and information
nodes.mandatory_action: Procure evidence and information related to the fraud incident.

nodes.text: Penal actions to be taken as per predefined matrix
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement penal actions according to the predefined matrix for fraud incidents.

nodes.text: Relevant gaps and controls be assessed for improvement
nodes.mandatory_action: Assess relevant gaps and controls for improvement after a fraud incident.

nodes.text: A consistent and credible disciplinary system is a key control for deterring fraud.
nodes.mandatory_action: Maintain a consistent and credible disciplinary system to deter fraud.

nodes.text: Post investigation based on evidence if it has been proven that there

nodes.mandatory_action: Communicate fraud awareness to customers/public on the organization's website and social media platforms.

nodes.mandatory_action: Promote a whistle-blow culture within the organization.

nodes.mandatory_action: The company must communicate with the customer if no resolution is available by the 15th day after grievance receipt.

nodes.text: A complaint/grievance shall be considered as disposed of and closed when: Where the complainant has indicated in writing, acceptance of the response of the insurer.
nodes.mandatory_action: The company must consider a grievance closed if the complainant has accepted the insurer's response in writing.

nodes.mandatory_action: The company must consider a grievance closed if the complainant does not respond within 8 weeks of the insurer's written response.

nodes.text: Where the Grievance Redressal Officer has certified that the company has discharged its contractual, statutory and regulatory obligations and therefore closes the complaint.

nodes.text: The organization shall form an Information Security Committee (ISC) headed by a senior level executive with a reporting line to the Board to take overall responsibility for the information security go
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must establish an Information Security Committee headed by a senior executive reporting to the Board.

nodes.text: The Information Security Committee (ISC) shall review and recommend to the Board necessary changes to the high level IS Policy.
nodes.mandatory_action: The ISC must review and recommend changes to the high level IS Policy to the Board.

nodes.text: The Committee shall approve standards and procedures in line with the Board-approved IS policy.
nodes.mandatory_action: The Committee must approve standards and procedures that align with the Board-approved IS policy.

nodes.text: Individual business functions should create and get their SOP’s approved (in line with above standards & procedures) by the respective functional heads.
nodes.mandatory_action: Business functions must create and obtain approval for their SOPs from functional heads.

nodes.text: Review and approve exceptions to the Information Security Policy, any significant risk to be reported to the Board.
nodes.mandatory_action: The ISC must review and approve exceptions to the Information Security Policy and report significant risks to the Board.

nodes.text: Operational level exceptions can be approved by Respective Business owner in consultation with CISO.
nodes.mandatory_action: Operational level exceptions must be approved by the respective business owner in consultation with the CISO.

nodes.text: Review, discuss and direct information security risk mitigation (which includes reporting security incidents) and ensure that risks are accurately reported and appropriately dealt with.
nodes.mandatory_action: The ISC must review and direct information security risk mitigation and ensure accurate reporting of risks.

nodes.text: Ensure compliance to regulatory and statutory requirements related Information Security.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must comply with all regulatory and statutory requirements related to Information Security.

nodes.text: The ISC shall ensure that the information security governance framework is supported by an information security assurance programme (Implementation Plan).
nodes.mandatory_action: The ISC must support the information security governance framework with an assurance programme.

nodes.text: ISC should report to Risk Management Committee of the Board a minimum of two times in a year.
nodes.mandatory_action: The ISC must report to the Risk Management Committee at least twice a year.

nodes.text: The Board shall demonstrate their commitment by approving the overall framework to information and cyber security policy and strategy.
nodes.mandatory_action: The Board must approve the overall information and cyber security policy and strategy framework.

nodes.text: The Board shall demonstrate their commitment by approving the information and cyber security assurance programme.
nodes.mandatory_action: The Board must approve the information and cyber security assurance programme.

nodes.text: Each functional Head shall provide leadership and sponsorship to the agreed security program by driving the same to the teams under their management and mandate compliance.
nodes.mandatory_action: Each functional Head must lead and sponsor the security program within their teams.

nodes.text: Individual functional head will be responsible for implementation of the security program.
nodes.mandatory_action: Each functional head is responsible for implementing the security program.

nodes.text: Organizations shall form a separate information security Team to focus exclusively on information security management.
nodes.mandatory_action: Organizations must establish a dedicated information security team.

nodes.text: There should be segregation of the duties of officials dealing exclusively with information systems security and the Information Technology Division which actually implements Information Security cont
nodes.mandatory_action: Duties must be segregated between information systems security officials and the IT Division.

nodes.text: The information security team should be adequately resourced in terms of the number of staff, level of skills and tools or techniques like risk.
nodes.mandatory_action: The information security team must be adequately resourced with sufficient staff, skills, and tools.

nodes.text: Information Security team shall: - a) Develop and maintain IS policy, standards, procedures and guidelines to support the organizations’ information security program.
nodes.mandatory_action: The Information Security team must develop and maintain the IS policy, standards, procedures, and guidelines.

nodes.text: b) Translate the information security program into specific actions which shall include awareness, security infrastructure, security incident response and risk management.
nodes.mandatory_action: The Information Security team must translate the information security program into specific actions including awareness and incident response.

nodes.text: However, the ultimate control and responsibility rests with the organization.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must retain ultimate control and responsibility for information security.

nodes.text: Technology/Operations/Admin/HR/ Functional teams shall – Have primary responsibility for ensuring that appropriate and adequate security mechanisms are provided in the systems and network infrastructu
nodes.mandatory_action: Functional teams must ensure appropriate security mechanisms are in place for systems and network infrastructure.

nodes.text: Have primary responsibility for ensuring that appropriate and adequate security mechanisms are provided in the systems and network infrastructure shared across systems and business units.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure appropriate and adequate security mechanisms are provided in shared systems and network infrastructure.

nodes.text: Be responsible for agreeing to security classification of all infrastructure components in agreement with the business owners.
nodes.mandatory_action: Agree to security classification of all infrastructure components with business owners.

nodes.text: Have primary ownership to comply with specific security policies, which will be applicable for systems development and acquisition.
nodes.mandatory_action: Comply with specific security policies for systems development and acquisition.

nodes.text: Be responsible for maintenance of the various security tools and solutions.
nodes.mandatory_action: Maintain various security tools and solutions.

nodes.text: Be responsible for monitoring of secure status on each system and network within its control. Report on weaknesses or breaches of security to be made to the relevant.
nodes.mandatory_action: Monitor secure status on systems and networks and report weaknesses or breaches of security.

nodes.text: Technology/Operations/Admin/HR/ functional teams shall designate a suitable and qualified team member who will be responsible for reporting the incidents & effectiveness of security control to CISO /I
nodes.mandatory_action: Designate a qualified team member for incident reporting and security control effectiveness.

nodes.text: Legal Team — Legal Team is responsible for Engagement with Cyber security police officials, lawyers and Government agencies as required.
nodes.mandatory_action: Engage with cybersecurity police officials, lawyers, and government agencies as necessary.

nodes.text: System users and data owners are responsible for the application of the policies relating to the systems, data, and other information resources under their care or control.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure system users and data owners apply relevant information security policies.

nodes.text: They are also responsible for reporting any suspected cyber security incident to Information Security Team/IT Head.
nodes.mandatory_action: Report any suspected cybersecurity incidents to the Information Security Team or IT Head.

nodes.text: Business owners shall hold the primary responsibility for defining the value and classification of assets within their control by participating in the risk management process and undertaking business
nodes.mandatory_action: Business owners must define the value and classification of assets and participate in risk management processes.

nodes.text: Business owners shall be responsible for authorizing access and segregation of duties for individual users and groups including Third parties to the information contained within the applications.
nodes.mandatory_action: Business owners must authorize access and ensure segregation of duties for users and third parties.

nodes.text: Business owners shall ensure that appropriate access of administration roles or teams exist for their applications to administer access in accordance with the IS Policy.
nodes.mandatory_action: Business owners must ensure appropriate administrative access roles are established for applications.

nodes.text: Business owners shall ensure implementation and compliance to Information Security Policies as applicable for their business units.
nodes.mandatory_action: Business owners must implement and comply with applicable Information Security Policies.

nodes.text: Business owners shall be primarily responsible for risk, data security and access of Third party partners.
nodes.mandatory_action: Business owners must manage risk, data security, and access for third-party partners.

nodes.text: Ensure implementation and compliance to Information Security Policies as applicable for their business units.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement and comply with Information Security Policies for business units.

nodes.text: Be primarily responsible for risk, data security and access of Third party partners and vendors to whom line of business has been outsourced.
nodes.mandatory_action: Take responsibility for risk and data security regarding third party partners and vendors.

nodes.text: Review the self-assessment of Third parties at defined frequency to whom line of business has been outsourced.
nodes.mandatory_action: Review third parties' self-assessments at a defined frequency.

nodes.text: Be responsible for conducting security assessments and audits of Third party processes / sites.
nodes.mandatory_action: Conduct security assessments and audits of third party processes and sites.

nodes.text: Define Information Security requirements for third parties in concurrence with the Information Security team of the organization
nodes.mandatory_action: Define Information Security requirements for third parties in collaboration with the Information Security team.

nodes.text: Senior management's primary responsibility shall be to develop a clear business aligned program for information security, assign roles and responsibilities, support the IS Policy and provide sponsorsh
nodes.mandatory_action: Senior management must develop and support a business-aligned information security program.

nodes.text: Information user's primary responsibility shall be to practice information security by working within the IS Policy and report promptly any unusual suspected or detected attempts to breach security.
nodes.mandatory_action: Information users must adhere to the IS Policy and report any security breaches promptly.

nodes.text: Internal Audit plan of the organization shall have a separate IS audit plan covering IT/Technology infrastructure and applications.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must have a separate IS audit plan as part of its Internal Audit plan.

nodes.text: Conduct audit for third party /vendors handling critical data on planned and ad hoc basis to measure the effectiveness of the third party security controls implemented.
nodes.mandatory_action: Audits must be conducted for third-party vendors handling critical data on a planned and ad hoc basis.

nodes.text: All instances of non-compliance related to Information security shall be communicated and discussed with relevant line management and CISO.
nodes.mandatory_action: Instances of non-compliance must be communicated and discussed with relevant line management and the CISO.

nodes.text: CISO shall provide the management and Users assistance in correcting deficiencies.
nodes.mandatory_action: The CISO must assist management and users in correcting deficiencies.

nodes.text: CISO shall bring significant issues on non-compliance to the attention of the ISC for review and remediation.
nodes.mandatory_action: The CISO must report significant non-compliance issues to the ISC for review and remediation.

nodes.text: CISO shall initiate / undertake an ongoing or ad hoc third party review/assessment of a specific function or a product to measure the effectiveness of the controls implemented and highlight any vulner
nodes.mandatory_action: The CISO must initiate ongoing or ad hoc reviews of third-party functions or products to assess control effectiveness and identify vulnerabilities.

nodes.text: Functional technology teams shall be responsible for undertaking regular monitoring of secure status on each system and network within its control.
nodes.mandatory_action: Functional technology teams must regularly monitor the secure status of systems and networks.

nodes.text: Functional technology teams shall report on weaknesses or breaches of security to the relevant Business Owners or Infrastructure Owners and to the CISO, who shall be responsible to manage the incident
nodes.mandatory_action: Functional technology teams must report security weaknesses or breaches to designated personnel.

nodes.text: All stakeholders (employees, contract staff etc.) are made aware of organizational information security policies, procedures and guidelines, threat exposures etc.
nodes.mandatory_action: All stakeholders must be made aware of information security policies and procedures.

nodes.text: They should be aware of their roles, responsibilities and abide by them to reduce the risk of human error.
nodes.mandatory_action: Stakeholders must understand and adhere to their roles and responsibilities regarding information security.

nodes.text: The organization shall ensure that all personnel who are assigned the responsibilities are competent to perform the required tasks and provided with regular training.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure all personnel are trained and competent for their assigned responsibilities.

nodes.text: All employees and, where applicable, contract staff, 3rd party service providers and vendors shall receive appropriate information security awareness training or periodic.
nodes.mandatory_action: Provide information security awareness training to all relevant personnel and vendors.

nodes.text: All employees and, where applicable, contract staff, 3rd party service providers and vendors shall receive appropriate information security awareness training or periodic updates as relevant to their
nodes.mandatory_action: All relevant personnel must receive information security awareness training or updates.

nodes.text: Identity management and access control arrangements shall be established to provide effective and consistent user administration by establishing identity accountability and authentication to allow bus
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish identity management and access control arrangements for user administration.

nodes.text: Access control mechanisms should: Limit access in line with access policies set by owners of business applications and systems.
nodes.mandatory_action: Limit access according to access policies set by application and system owners.

nodes.text: Access control mechanisms should: Restrict the business application/system/ network/computing device capabilities that can be accessed (e.g. by providing menus /groups that enable access only to the p
nodes.mandatory_action: Restrict access capabilities of business applications and systems to fulfill defined roles.

nodes.text: Access control mechanisms should: Supplement passwords (e.g. by using strong authentication such as smartcards, biometrics or tokens), if and when necessary.
nodes.mandatory_action: Supplement passwords with strong authentication methods when necessary.

nodes.text: Supplement passwords (e.g. by using strong authentication such as smartcards, biometrics or tokens), if and when necessary.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement strong authentication methods for passwords as needed.

nodes.text: Minimize the need for special access privileges (e.g. User IDs that have additional capabilities, such as 'Administrator', or special capabilities, such as User IDs that can be used to authorize payme
nodes.mandatory_action: Reduce the use of special access privileges for user accounts.

nodes.text: Require approval/s business application/system/ network/ computing device from appropriate authority to provide access privileges for both business users and computer staff.
nodes.mandatory_action: Obtain necessary approvals for access privileges from the appropriate authority.

nodes.text: Have a process for terminating the access of normal users as well as privileged users.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish a process to terminate access for all users.

nodes.text: Be reviewed on Periodic basis.
nodes.mandatory_action: Conduct periodic reviews of access privileges.

nodes.text: Details of Business owner, approvers and their delegated authority shall be maintained and be re-certified and updated periodically.
nodes.mandatory_action: Maintain and periodically update details of business owners and approvers along with their delegated authority.

nodes.text: The authorization process shall include process for granting emergency access.
nodes.mandatory_action: Include a process for granting emergency access in the authorization procedures.

nodes.text: All ‘Users’ shall be authenticated at a minimum by using User IDs and passwords, before they can gain access to target systems to prevent Unauthorized access to the Organization’s information assets.
nodes.mandatory_action: Users must be authenticated using User IDs and passwords before accessing target systems.

nodes.text: Access shall be timely modified as required when 'Users' moves internally
nodes.mandatory_action: Timely modify access for users when they move internally.

nodes.text: Access shall be timely revoked when 'Users' exits
nodes.mandatory_action: Timely revoke access for users when they exit the organization.

nodes.text: All user-IDs and their access right shall be reviewed by the respective functional business owner on a regular basis to avoid existence of stray/orphan user accounts and ensuring that access rights ar
nodes.mandatory_action: Regularly review all user-IDs and their access rights to prevent orphan accounts and ensure access is based on need-to-know.

nodes.text: The review shall include verification that the user's access rights and privileges are still in line with job requirements.
nodes.mandatory_action: Verify that user access rights and privileges align with job requirements during reviews.

nodes.text: Generic User-Ids/Service IDs shall be avoided and where no alternative exists, it shall be controlled, authorized by Business/Asset Owner, to avoid misuse to compromise user accountability.
nodes.mandatory_action: Avoid generic user-IDs/Service IDs and control them if no alternative exists.

nodes.text: Privilege generic user-IDs shall allow the user to only perform the intended activities for which the user-IDs was created. Such IDs shall be authorized by business/Asset owners
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure privilege generic user-IDs are authorized and limited to intended activities.

nodes.text: Remote access to the Organization’s infrastructure shall be highly restricted and controlled to prevent unauthorized access to the Organization’s infrastructure from untrusted networks
nodes.mandatory_action: Restrict and control remote access to the organization's infrastructure.

nodes.text: Users seeking to gain privileged access to the Organization’s IT facilities via public or other external networks shall do so via two factor authentications.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement two-factor authentication for privileged access via external networks.

nodes.text: Changes to business applications, computer Systems and networks shall follow a change management process covering associated Risks, Change authorization, Business Continuity and impact.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish a change management process for business applications, computer systems, and networks.

nodes.text: A change management process shall be established, which covers all types of change (e.g. upgrades and modifications to application and software, modifications to business).
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish a comprehensive change management process that includes all types of changes.

nodes.text: The change management process shall be documented, and include approving and testing changes to ensure that:
nodes.mandatory_action: Document the change management process and include approval and testing of changes.

nodes.text: There shall be implementation plan for executing a change that includes but not limited to:
nodes.mandatory_action: Create an implementation plan for executing changes.

nodes.text: All changes shall be monitored and reviewed for successful implementation and documented, they shall:
nodes.mandatory_action: Monitor and review all changes for successful implementation and document the process.

nodes.text: All changes shall be monitored and reviewed for successful implementation and documented.
nodes.mandatory_action: All changes must be monitored, reviewed, and documented for successful implementation.

nodes.text: Be performed by skilled and competent individuals who are capable of making changes correctly and securely.
nodes.mandatory_action: Changes must be performed by skilled and competent individuals.

nodes.text: Developer and Release Manager / Deployment team access should be segregated.
nodes.mandatory_action: Access for Developer and Release Manager/Deployment team must be segregated.

nodes.text: Be signed off by appropriate business owners.
nodes.mandatory_action: Changes must be signed off by appropriate business owners.

nodes.text: Have a record of version control and capture what was changed when and by whom.
nodes.mandatory_action: A record of version control must be maintained, capturing changes, dates, and responsible individuals.

nodes.text: Have communication of details to relevant individuals and checks be performed to confirm that only intended changes have been made.
nodes.mandatory_action: Details of changes must be communicated to relevant individuals, and checks must be performed to confirm intended changes.

nodes.text: Ensure that documents associated with computer systems and networks are updated.
nodes.mandatory_action: Documents associated with computer systems and networks must be updated.

nodes.text: Adequate control shall be implanted to ensure data integrity and confidentiality during/after data migration and its completeness shall be verified.
nodes.mandatory_action: Adequate controls must be implemented to ensure data integrity and confidentiality during and after data migration.

nodes.text: Digital records created are to be adequately preserved over time and remain accessible and functional, even over successive changes in technology.
nodes.mandatory_action: Digital records must be preserved over time and remain accessible and functional.

nodes.text: Information security requirements shall be considered at all stages throughout third party/vendors having access/handling the organizational system/data.
nodes.mandatory_action: N/A

nodes.mandatory_action: Establish a process for managing security with external parties.

nodes.mandatory_action: Involve the information security function in the vendor risk management process and agree on security arrangements with external parties.

nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure all vendor arrangements include a well-defined SLA specifying information security requirements and controls.

nodes.text: External party shall demonstrate compliance with all SLA requirements.
nodes.mandatory_action: Require external parties to demonstrate compliance with SLA requirements.

nodes.text: Validating security arrangements for each vendor.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement a process for validating security arrangements for each vendor.

nodes.text: Handling termination of a relationship with a vendor.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish procedures for handling the termination of vendor relationships.

nodes.text: Sub-contracting arrangements should cover due diligence aspects.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure sub-contracting arrangements include due diligence aspects.

nodes.text: External parties shall be subject to a relationship assessment (sometimes referred to as due diligence review) shall cover:

nodes.text: Contract requirements shall include non-disclosure agreements, sub-contracting, roles
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure contracts with external parties include non-disclosure agreements and sub-contracting roles.

nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must include specific contract requirements related to non-disclosure, sub-contracting, roles, responsibilities, termination clauses, and audit rights in their agreements.

nodes.text: Risk assessment shall be conducted for determining the risks involved in granting access
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must conduct risk assessments to determine risks associated with granting access.

nodes.text: Confidentiality and non-disclosure agreements with third parties shall be reviewed periodically and whenever the service terms and conditions are changed.
nodes.mandatory_action: Review confidentiality and non-disclosure agreements with third parties periodically and upon changes to service terms.

nodes.text: Access management for third parties including granting access, review of user access rights shall be periodically assessed and changed as applicable.
nodes.mandatory_action: Periodically assess and change access management for third parties.

nodes.text: In case of third party including Call Centre operations, the Operating system has to be hardened to prevent data leakages.
nodes.mandatory_action: Harden the operating system for third parties including Call Centre operations to prevent data leakages.

nodes.text: External parties requiring review of internal control shall be identified on a periodic basis.
nodes.mandatory_action: Identify external parties for internal control review on a periodic basis.

nodes.text: External parties requiring review of internal control shall be identified on a periodic basis
nodes.mandatory_action: Identify external parties for internal control review periodically.

nodes.text: Review findings shall be communicated to external party and corrective action shall be monitored.
nodes.mandatory_action: Communicate review findings to external parties and monitor corrective actions.

nodes.mandatory_action: Establish a consistent method for securely handling termination of relationships with parties.

nodes.mandatory_action: Revisit security considerations prior to the renewal of engagements.

nodes.text: Alternative (contingency) arrangements shall be established to ensure that the organization’s business processes can continue in the event that the external party is not available.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish alternative arrangements for business continuity in case of external party unavailability.

nodes.text: Organization to evaluate Escrow for information systems source code for and end of support / proprietary technologies using a trusted external party, such as a legal representative, lawyer or equivale
nodes.mandatory_action: Evaluate escrow arrangements for information systems source code and proprietary technologies.

nodes.text: Recovery arrangement to ensure continued availability of information stored at an outsource Provider.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must establish recovery arrangements for information stored with outsource providers.

nodes.text: Alignment with the organization’s business continuity program.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure alignment of their information security practices with the business continuity program.

nodes.text: Assets associated with information and information processing facilities should be identified and an inventory of these assets should be drawn up and maintained.
nodes.mandatory_action: Identify organizational assets and maintain an inventory of them.

nodes.text: The asset owner should ensure that assets are inventoried.
nodes.mandatory_action: Asset owners must ensure that all assets are inventoried.

nodes.text: The asset owner should ensure that assets are appropriately classified and protected.
nodes.mandatory_action: Asset owners must classify and protect all assets appropriately.

nodes.text: The asset owner should define and periodically review access restrictions and classifications to important assets, taking into account applicable access control policies.
nodes.mandatory_action: Asset owners must define and periodically review access restrictions and classifications for important assets.

nodes.text: The asset owner should ensure proper handling when the asset is deleted or destroyed.
nodes.mandatory_action: Asset owners must ensure proper handling of assets during deletion or destruction.

nodes.mandatory_action: Employees and external party users must return all organizational assets upon termination.

nodes.text: The termination process should be formalized to include the return of all previously issued physical and electronic assets owned by or entrusted to the organization.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must formalize the termination process to ensure asset return.

nodes.text: Procedures should be followed to ensure that all relevant information is transferred to the organization and securely erased from the equipment.
nodes.mandatory_action: Procedures must be established for transferring and securely erasing information from equipment.

nodes.text: An appropriate set of procedures for information labeling should be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must develop and implement procedures for information labeling.

nodes.text: Media should be disposed of securely when no longer required, using formal procedures.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must dispose of media securely when it is no longer required, following formal procedures.

nodes.text: Surveillance systems shall be in place and regularly monitored to cover all major areas
nodes.mandatory_action: Surveillance systems must be implemented and monitored regularly.

nodes.text: Secure areas should be protected by appropriate entry controls to ensure that only authorized personnel are allowed access.
nodes.mandatory_action: Entry controls must be established to restrict access to secure areas to authorized personnel only.

nodes.text: Access rights to secure areas should be regularly reviewed and updated, and revoked when necessary.
nodes.mandatory_action: Access rights to secure areas must be reviewed and updated regularly, with revocations as needed.

nodes.text: Appropriate controls shall be implemented to manage calamities like fire, flood, earthquake, explosion, civil unrest and other forms of natural or man-made disaster.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement appropriate controls to manage calamities.

nodes.text: Mock drills shall be conducted periodically to test the effectiveness of the controls.
nodes.mandatory_action: Conduct mock drills periodically to test control effectiveness.

nodes.text: Users should ensure that unattended equipment has appropriate protection.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure unattended equipment has appropriate protection.

nodes.text: Secure computers or mobile devices from unauthorized use by a key lock or an equivalent control, e.g. password access, when not in use.
nodes.mandatory_action: Secure computers or mobile devices from unauthorized use when not in use.

nodes.mandatory_action: Adopt a clear desk and clear screen policy.

nodes.mandatory_action: Conduct background verification checks on all candidates for employment as per relevant laws and proportional to business needs.

nodes.mandatory_action: Communicate information security roles and responsibilities to job candidates during pre-employment.

nodes.mandatory_action: Implement a code of conduct outlining information security responsibilities for employees and contractors.

nodes.mandatory_action: The Organization must implement a risk management program for periodic information security risk assessments.

nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must execute monitoring procedures to identify failed and successful security breaches and incidents promptly.

nodes.text: Enable management to determine whether the security activities delegated to people or implemented by information technology are performing as expected
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must enable management to determine the performance of delegated security activities.

nodes.text: Determine the actions taken to resolve a breach of security, reflecting business priorities
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must determine and document the actions taken to resolve security breaches.

nodes.text: Undertake regular reviews of the effectiveness of the IRM work plan
nodes.mandatory_action: Regular reviews of the effectiveness of the IRM work plan must be undertaken.

nodes.text: Review the level of residual risk and acceptable risk
nodes.mandatory_action: The level of residual risk and acceptable risk must be reviewed.

nodes.text: Maintain and Improve Information Risk Management
nodes.mandatory_action: Information Risk Management must be maintained and improved.

nodes.text: Implement the identified improvements in the IRM work plan
nodes.mandatory_action: Identified improvements in the IRM work plan must be implemented.

nodes.text: Take appropriate corrective and preventive actions
nodes.mandatory_action: Appropriate corrective and preventive actions must be taken.

nodes.text: Communicate the results and actions to concerned teams and consult with CISO on improvement plans
nodes.mandatory_action: Results and actions must be communicated to concerned teams and the CISO must be consulted on improvement plans.

nodes.text: Ensure that the improvements achieve their intended objective
nodes.mandatory_action: Improvements must be ensured to achieve their intended objective.

nodes.text: The information security policy shall cover elements on the acceptable use for the end users which will help build a secure environment across the organization.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must develop an information security policy that includes acceptable use elements for end users.

nodes.text: The acceptable use policy shall cover: Information classification and labeling, Password management, Endpoints (desktop/laptop and mobile devices)
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must create an acceptable use policy that includes information classification, password management, and endpoint security.

nodes.text: The Organization shall have a Business continuity policy, with clearly identified responsibilities
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must establish a Business Continuity Policy with defined responsibilities.

nodes.text: The Policy shall be communicated to all the persons involved with or responsible for business continuity at various levels in the Organization
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must communicate the Business Continuity Policy to all relevant personnel.

nodes.text: The Policy shall be reviewed at periodically or in case of any significant changes
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must periodically review the Business Continuity Policy or when significant changes occur.

nodes.text: Necessary resources like work area and manpower, etc. to be provided for effective BC implementation and operation
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must allocate necessary resources for effective Business Continuity implementation and operation.

nodes.text: The BC policy to be communicated and available to the employees
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must ensure the BC policy is communicated and accessible to all employees.

nodes.text: Staff training programs for the concerned employees
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must conduct staff training programs for employees involved in business continuity.

nodes.text: Business impact analysis to be conducted to identify the critical business processes, resources needed to support them and the impact measurement in time in case of unavailability
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must conduct a business impact analysis to identify critical business processes and their resource needs.

nodes.text: There shall be a defined method for determining the impact of any disruption to key business processes
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must establish a defined method for assessing the impact of disruptions to key business processes.

nodes.text: The Organization shall identify suitable Business Continuity arrangements to recover identified critical activities within acceptable time.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must identify and implement suitable business continuity arrangements for critical activities.

nodes.text: The Organization shall develop Emergency response structure that will manage incident and ensure continuity of its critical activities
nodes.mandatory_action: The Organization must develop an Emergency response structure for incident management and continuity of critical activities.

nodes.text: The Organization shall validate the on-going effectiveness of its Business Continuity planning via periodic testing and Prepare the report of the exercise, outcome and learning including required acti
nodes.mandatory_action: The Organization must validate the effectiveness of its Business Continuity planning through periodic testing and prepare a report on the outcomes and required actions.

nodes.text: The Management shall review the Organization’s business continuity preparedness at planned intervals or when significant changes occur
nodes.mandatory_action: The Management must review the Organization's business continuity preparedness at planned intervals or after significant changes.

nodes.text: Organizations shall recognize that the efficient management of its data security is necessary to support its core functions, to comply with its statutory and regulatory obligations and to contribute t
nodes.mandatory_action: Organizations must efficiently manage their data security to comply with statutory and regulatory obligations.

nodes.text: Organizations need to define and implement procedures to ensure the Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability and Consistency of all data stored in different forms.
nodes.mandatory_action: Organizations must define and implement procedures for data security management.

nodes.text: organizations shall ensure due care of security to the Confidentiality, integrity and availability.
nodes.mandatory_action: Organizations must ensure due care of security to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data throughout its lifecycle.

nodes.text: organizations shall ensure due care of security to the Confidentiality, integrity and availability
nodes.mandatory_action: Organizations must ensure due care of security to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data.

nodes.text: Consistency & accuracy of data entered into the system should be verified through a maker checker process wherever applicable.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement a maker checker process to verify data consistency and accuracy.

nodes.text: There should be a process to ensure that such maker/ checker functions for conflicting roles follow segregation of duties and the same user cannot perform both the functions.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish a process to enforce segregation of duties in maker/checker functions.

nodes.text: Audit trail of critical data access shall be maintained.
nodes.mandatory_action: Maintain an audit trail for critical data access.

nodes.text: Audit trails should be secured to ensure the integrity of the information captured, including the preservation of evidence.
nodes.mandatory_action: Secure audit trails to protect the integrity of captured information.

nodes.text: Retention of audit trails should be in line with business, regulatory and legal requirements.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure audit trail retention complies with business, regulatory, and legal requirements.

nodes.text: Access should be provided on 'Need to Know' or 'Least Privileges' based to ensure that necessary personnel (Employee) have access to essential system & this access should be reviewed periodically.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement access controls based on 'Need to Know' and 'Least Privileges' principles and conduct periodic reviews.

nodes.text: For data generated /created on paper, user shall ensure that it follows data classification.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure that paper-generated data adheres to data classification standards.

nodes.text: user shall ensure that it follows data classification policy, stores it in a safe place in the office and maintain the CIA of data.
nodes.mandatory_action: Users must follow the data classification policy and ensure the security of data stored on paper.

nodes.text: Organizations should have a process to verify job application information on all new employees.
nodes.mandatory_action: Organizations must implement a verification process for job application information of new employees.

nodes.text: Organizations should verify that contractors are also subject to similar screening procedures.
nodes.mandatory_action: Organizations must ensure that contractors undergo similar screening procedures as new employees.

nodes.text: Once the data is classified, it shall be the responsibility of users to ensure that adequate controls followed as per policy and an inventory of critical data storage locations shall be identified & d
nodes.mandatory_action: Users must ensure adequate controls are followed for classified data and maintain an inventory of critical data storage locations.

nodes.text: a mechanism to identify critical data based on its impact to the business shall be defined.
nodes.mandatory_action: Organizations must define a mechanism to identify critical data based on its business impact.

nodes.text: locations shall be identified & documented
nodes.mandatory_action: Identify and document locations.

nodes.text: a mechanism to identify critical data based on its impact to the business shall be defined
nodes.mandatory_action: Define a mechanism to identify critical data based on its business impact.

nodes.text: Regular awareness program to the users about handling of the critical data, classification levels of data shall be imparted on regular basis
nodes.mandatory_action: Impart regular awareness programs to users about handling critical data and its classification levels.

nodes.text: Confidentiality undertaking shall be obtained from the users
nodes.mandatory_action: Obtain confidentiality undertakings from users.

nodes.text: The critical data on the laptops and other mobile devices shall be protected to avoid disclosure of data in case of loss of the laptop or other devices
nodes.mandatory_action: Protect critical data on laptops and mobile devices to prevent disclosure in case of loss.

nodes.text: There should be secure storage of media
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure secure storage of media with appropriate controls.

nodes.text: Controls could include physical and environmental controls such as fire and flood protection, limiting access by means like physical locks, keypad, passwords, biometrics, etc., labeling, and logged ac
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement physical and environmental controls for secure storage of media.

nodes.text: Cryptographic/password management techniques need to be used to control access to critical and sensitive data/information in transit and storage
nodes.mandatory_action: Use cryptographic and password management techniques to control access to critical and sensitive data.

nodes.text: Cryptographic/password management techniques need to be used to control access to critical and sensitive data/information in transit and storage.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must implement cryptographic/password management techniques for access control.

nodes.text: Sensitive data if required to be sent to outsource services provider, third party for business purpose, shall be approved by the information/ business owner and controls are designed to ensure that da
nodes.mandatory_action: Sensitive data sent to third parties must be approved and controlled to prevent misuse.

nodes.text: Adequate controls to maintain data integrity and confidentiality while data is being archived shall be maintained.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement controls to ensure data integrity and confidentiality during archiving.

nodes.text: Disposal mechanisms should ensure the effective destruction of data.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish and follow disposal mechanisms for effective data destruction.

nodes.text: all extant copies should be located and destroyed.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must locate and destroy all extant copies of digital records.

nodes.text: Each application to have an owner.
nodes.mandatory_action: Each application must have an assigned owner.

nodes.text: Ensuring that adequate controls are built into the application through active involvement in the application design, development, testing and change process
nodes.mandatory_action: Adequate controls must be built into applications through active involvement in their design, development, testing, and change processes.

nodes.text: Ensuring that the Change Management process is followed for any changes in the application
nodes.mandatory_action: The Change Management process must be followed for any changes in applications.

nodes.text: Ensuring that the security of the application has been reviewed
nodes.mandatory_action: The security of applications must be reviewed.

nodes.text: Informing the information security team regarding purchase of an application and assessing the application based on the security policy requirements
nodes.mandatory_action: The information security team must be informed about application purchases and applications must be assessed based on security policy requirements.

nodes.text: Ensuring that the new applications being purchased/developed follow the Information Security policy
nodes.mandatory_action: New applications being purchased or developed must follow the Information Security policy.

nodes.text: Ensuring that logs or audit trails, as required, are enabled and monitored for the applications. Logs should at least meet who-when-what-where criteria based on criticality.
nodes.mandatory_action: Logs or audit trails must be enabled and monitored for applications, meeting specified criteria.

nodes.text: Ensuring that logs or audit trails, as required, are enabled and monitored for the applications.
nodes.mandatory_action: Logs or audit trails must be enabled and monitored for applications.

nodes.text: Maintain last login details for all internet portal applications
nodes.mandatory_action: Last login details must be maintained for all internet portal applications.

nodes.text: Ensure review of access and roles are conducted periodically
nodes.mandatory_action: Access and roles must be reviewed periodically.

nodes.text: The information security related requirements are included in the requirements for the development of the new information systems or enhancements in the existing information systems
nodes.mandatory_action: Include information security requirements in system development specifications.

nodes.text: Security requirements relating to system access control, authentication, transaction authorization, data integrity, system activity logging, audit trail, security event tracking and exception handling
nodes.mandatory_action: Clearly specify security requirements at the initial stages of system development or acquisition.

nodes.text: There should be a proper linkage between a change request and the corresponding action taken
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish a linkage between change requests and actions taken.

nodes.text: Any changes to an application system/data need to be justified by genuine business need and approvals supported by documentation and subjected to a robust change management process
nodes.mandatory_action: Justify changes to application systems/data with business need and proper documentation through a change management process.

nodes.text: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system implementation efforts
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish, document, maintain, and apply secure system engineering principles for information system implementations.

nodes.text: There should be documented standards/procedures for administering the application and updated periodically
nodes.mandatory_action: Document and periodically update standards/procedures for application administration.

nodes.text: Potential security weaknesses / breaches should be identified. There should be measures to reduce the risk of theft, fraud, error and unauthorized changes to information through measures like supervis
nodes.mandatory_action: Identify potential security weaknesses and implement measures to reduce risks of theft, fraud, error, and unauthorized changes.

nodes.text: Applications must not allow unauthorized entries to be updated in the database.
nodes.mandatory_action: Applications must implement controls to prevent unauthorized database updates.

nodes.text: Applications must not allow any modifications to be made after an entry is authorized.
nodes.mandatory_action: Applications must restrict modifications after authorization of entries.

nodes.text: Robust input validation controls, processing and output controls needs to be built in to the application.
nodes.mandatory_action: Applications must implement robust input validation and processing controls.

nodes.text: Critical Applications to provide for, logging unsuccessful logon attempts, access to sensitive options in the application, e.g., master record changes, granting of access rights, use of system utiliti
nodes.mandatory_action: Critical applications must log unsuccessful logon attempts and access to sensitive options.

nodes.text: The audit trails need to be stored as per a defined period as per any internal/regulatory/statutory requirements and it should be ensured that they are not tampered with
nodes.mandatory_action: Audit trails must be stored according to defined periods and protected from tampering.

nodes.text: Organizations shall establish and appropriately protect secure development environments for system development and integration efforts that cover the entire system development life-cycle
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish and protect secure development environments for the entire system development life-cycle.

nodes.text: The development, test and production environments need to be properly segregated, any exceptions to be signed off by the ISC.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure proper segregation of development, test, and production environments, with exceptions signed off by the ISC.

nodes.text: Access should be based on the principle of least privilege and “need to know” commensurate with the job responsibilities. Adequate segregation of duties needs to be enforced
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement access controls based on least privilege and enforce adequate segregation of duties.

nodes.text: The IT/Business team should review the activity of outsourced system development.
nodes.mandatory_action: Review the activities of outsourced system development by the IT/Business team.

nodes.text: Organization may obtain application integrity statements in writing from the application system vendors providing for reasonable level of assurance about the application being free of malware at the t
nodes.mandatory_action: Obtain application integrity statements from application system vendors.

nodes.text: All application systems to be tested during the implementation in a robust manner regarding functionality controls to ensure that they satisfy business policies/rules of the organization and regulator
nodes.mandatory_action: Test all application systems during implementation for functionality controls.

nodes.text: Robust system based controls need to be built into the system and thereby reducing the reliance on any manual controls
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must build robust system-based controls to minimize reliance on manual controls.

nodes.text: All applications to be tested for security controls to check for known vulnerabilities initially and during major changes.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must test all applications for security controls against known vulnerabilities at the start and during major changes.

nodes.text: Before the system is live, there should be clarity on the audit trails and the specific fields that are required to be captured as part of audit trails and an audit trail or log monitoring process inc
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure clarity on audit trails and the specific fields to be captured before the system goes live, along with a monitoring process.

nodes.text: Direct back-end updates to database should not be allowed except during exigencies, with a clear business need and after due authorization as per the relevant policy.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement controls to restrict direct back-end updates to the database.

nodes.text: Applications should be configured to logout the users after a specific period of inactivity.
nodes.mandatory_action: Configure applications to automatically logout users after a defined inactivity period.

nodes.text: There should be suitable interface controls in place to prevent any unauthorized modification.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish interface controls to prevent unauthorized modifications.

nodes.text: Establish a suitable backup policy for the application.
nodes.mandatory_action: Develop and implement a backup policy for applications.

nodes.text: A well-functioning cyber security management program consistent with cyber resilience best practices should be in place and verified.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must implement and verify a cyber security management program aligned with best practices.

nodes.text: a well-functioning cyber security management program consistent with cyber resilience best practices should be in place and verified through supervisory review.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish and verify a cyber security management program consistent with best practices.

nodes.text: Appropriate degree of IT controls shall be ensured for outsourced activities.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure IT controls are implemented for outsourced activities.

nodes.text: Availability factor of portals should be part of contracting and sourcing.
nodes.mandatory_action: Include availability factors in contracting and sourcing processes.

nodes.text: Protection from DDoS Vectors needs to be part of sourcing and monitoring.
nodes.mandatory_action: Incorporate DDoS protection in sourcing and monitoring activities.

nodes.text: Appropriate access controls along with restriction based on least privileges roles should be part of application and access control design.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must implement appropriate access controls based on least privilege roles in their application and access control design.

nodes.text: For critical systems cyber security monitoring is essential, as performing security events monitoring and or analytics would assist in detection and mitigation cyber incidents.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must implement cyber security monitoring for critical systems to assist in detection and mitigation of cyber incidents.

nodes.text: Incident response planning is of great importance.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must develop and maintain an incident response plan.

nodes.text: Resumption of services (if interrupted) should be achieved within a reasonable timeframe, depending on the impact of the incidents and the criticality of the service.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that services are resumed within a reasonable timeframe after an incident, based on impact and criticality.

nodes.text: Testing should be included when systems are specified, developed, and integrated.
nodes.mandatory_action: Include testing in the specification, development, and integration of systems.

nodes.text: Cyber security incidents which are critically affecting the business operations and large number of customers should be reported to IRDAI within a Maximum period of 48 hours, upon knowledge.
nodes.mandatory_action: Organizations must report critical cyber security incidents to IRDAI within 48 hours.

nodes.text: Organizations must report information security incidents, where the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of critical information is potentially compromised, to the IRDAI and Cert-Fin.
nodes.mandatory_action: Organizations must report information security incidents affecting critical information to IRDAI and Cert-Fin.

nodes.text: Organizations must report information security incidents, where the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of critical information is potentially compromised, to the IRDAI and Cert-Fin with the r
nodes.mandatory_action: Organizations must report information security incidents within 48 hours of identification.

nodes.text: Organization shall develop baseline SCD based on OEM’s recommendations and industry best practices.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must develop baseline Secure Configuration Documents (SCD) according to OEM recommendations and industry best practices.

nodes.text: SCD should be reviewed for currency on a periodic basis by Information Security Team.
nodes.mandatory_action: The Information Security Team must review the SCD for currency periodically.

nodes.text: The exceptions to configurations as recommended in SCDs owning to certain business requirements/limitations should be approved through formal exception process after adequate risk assessment.
nodes.mandatory_action: Formal exceptions to SCD configurations must be approved after a risk assessment.

nodes.text: The IT infrastructure should be subject to configuration review (vulnerability assessment/penetration tests) against defined SCDs on a periodic basis.
nodes.mandatory_action: Conduct periodic configuration reviews and vulnerability assessments for the IT infrastructure against defined SCDs.

nodes.text: Regular scheduled assessments, such as internal and external vulnerability scans should be conducted for the IT Infrastructure including but not limited to software, applications, server, network, dat
nodes.mandatory_action: Conduct regular internal and external vulnerability scans for the IT infrastructure.

nodes.text: All Internet facing applications shall undergo vulnerability assessments before deployment in the production environment.
nodes.mandatory_action: Conduct vulnerability assessments for all Internet facing applications before deployment.

nodes.text: Organization’s IT infrastructure should be updated with the supported, tested and reasonably latest OS and database patches including security patches and upgradation patches.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must update its IT infrastructure with the latest OS and database patches.

nodes.text: Impact analysis and testing shall be performed for the recommended new patches, before deploying those in production environment.
nodes.mandatory_action: Impact analysis and testing must be conducted for new patches before deployment.

nodes.text: For the patches causing adverse impact or non-availability of business applications, exception approval documents should be maintained for future reference and audit purpose.
nodes.mandatory_action: Exception approval documents must be maintained for patches causing adverse impact.

nodes.text: Patches for end-points may be tested in test environment before implementation on the user machines.
nodes.mandatory_action: Patches for end-points must be tested in a test environment before implementation.

nodes.text: Network shall be segmented into zones/subnets based on function and possibly location.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must segment its network into zones/subnets based on function and possibly location.

nodes.text: All network devices should be HARDENED based on their respective secure configuration documents before being deployed in production.
nodes.mandatory_action: All network devices must be hardened according to secure configuration documents prior to deployment.

nodes.text: Defence-in-depth through placement of IDS/IPS solution shall be implemented to further control the internet traffic passing through these networks.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must implement a defence-in-depth strategy by placing IDS/IPS solutions to control internet traffic.

nodes.text: These solutions shall be regularly updated with current signatures / characteristics of threats.
nodes.mandatory_action: Solutions must be regularly updated with current signatures/characteristics of threats.

nodes.text: Remote access to organization’s network resources over an un-trusted network (Internet/Extranet) shall be integrated into the overall network security management.
nodes.mandatory_action: Remote access must be integrated into the overall network security management.

nodes.text: Clocks of all relevant information processing systems within an organization or security domain shall be synchronized with an agreed accurate time source.
nodes.mandatory_action: Clocks of information processing systems must be synchronized with an accurate time source.

nodes.text: Routing controls should be implemented for networks to ensure that computer connections and information flows do not breach the access control system of the business applications.
nodes.mandatory_action: Routing controls must be implemented to prevent breaches of access control systems.

nodes.text: There should be segregation of duties for approval and implementation of configurations for network devices.
nodes.mandatory_action: Segregation of duties must be established for network device configurations.

nodes.text: Adequate redundancy should be provided for network links and network devices.
nodes.mandatory_action: Adequate redundancy must be provided for network links and devices.

nodes.text: REDUNDANT NETWORK LINKS AND DEVICES SHOULD HAVE THE SAME LEVEL OF SECURITY AS THE PRIMARY LINKS.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure that redundant network links and devices are secured at the same level as primary links.

nodes.text: All single points of failure within the organization network shall be identified and the risks in such a design shall be assessed.
nodes.mandatory_action: Identify all single points of failure in the network and assess associated risks.

nodes.text: Where possible, failover technologies shall be in place to address network failure.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement failover technologies to mitigate network failure risks where feasible.

nodes.text: Network diagram (including wireless network) shall be documented and kept up to date.
nodes.mandatory_action: Document and maintain an up-to-date network diagram, including wireless components.

nodes.text: Logs generated by critical network devices shall be collected and analyzed to identify threats and exceptions.
nodes.mandatory_action: Collect and analyze logs from critical network devices to detect threats and exceptions.

nodes.text: Network security shall be monitored through a Security Operations Centre (SOC) to provide immediate response to threats.
nodes.mandatory_action: Monitor network security through a Security Operations Centre (SOC) for immediate threat response.

nodes.text: Digital signatures/certificates shall be acquired from the Certificate Authority (CA) licensed by the Controller of Certifying Authorities (CCA) India.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must acquire digital signatures/certificates from a licensed Certificate Authority.

nodes.text: Accountability / responsibility for management of master keys shall be formally assigned within the organization in case of internal CA.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must formally assign accountability for master key management.

nodes.text: Key custodians must be made aware of their role and they shall formally acknowledge their obligations in administering the security of the keys.
nodes.mandatory_action: Key custodians must acknowledge their obligations regarding key security.

nodes.text: Master keys for symmetric key/asymmetric key pair generation must be secured in a manner such that no one individual party is privy to the entire master key, wherever applicable.
nodes.mandatory_action: Master keys must be secured to prevent any single individual from having full access.

nodes.text: Keys/asymmetric key pairs shall be changed whenever a compromise occurs (or thought to occur), and whenever a party who is privy to a key/the private key component of the key pair, leaves the organiza
nodes.mandatory_action: Keys must be changed upon compromise or personnel changes.

nodes.text: A formal process must exist to revoke symmetric keys/asymmetric key pairs in a timely and effective manner.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish a formal process for timely revocation of keys.

nodes.text: Revoked keys shall be destroyed.
nodes.mandatory_action: Revoked keys must be destroyed.

nodes.text: Key backup process shall enable key recovery, but should not compromise key confidentiality and integrity.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement a key backup process that maintains confidentiality and integrity.

nodes.text: Request for recovery of keys/key pairs shall be made via a formal process that includes approval from competent authority.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish a formal process for key recovery requests that includes competent authority approval.

nodes.text: Data encryption keys – symmetric/asymmetric keys used for encryption shall be available as long as any information protected (encrypted) by the keys needs to be decrypted.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure data encryption keys are retained as long as the encrypted information requires decryption.

nodes.text: A public key shall be available as long as any information signed with the associated private key is maintained.
nodes.mandatory_action: Retain the public key for as long as the signed information is maintained.

nodes.text: Master keys shall be available as long as there is a requirement to recreate derived keys in the future.
nodes.mandatory_action: Maintain master keys for the duration required to recreate derived keys.

nodes.text: Keys used to generate hash algorithms shall be available as long as there is a requirement to prove or otherwise the validity of a previously generated hash value.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure retention of keys used for hash generation as long as needed to validate hash values.

nodes.text: Organizations shall establish logging and monitoring capabilities to detect security events in timely manner.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish logging and monitoring capabilities for security events.

nodes.text: Security logs shall be enabled on all critical information assets.
nodes.mandatory_action: Enable security logs on all critical information assets.

nodes.text: Security Logs generated by different systems and devices shall be collected such that linking (correlating) events generated across these systems and devices is possible and should be maintained for a
nodes.mandatory_action: Collect and maintain security logs for a minimum of six months and ensure they can be correlated across systems.

nodes.text: Security logs shall be made available to the Law enforcement agencies, IRDAI and Cert-Fin as and when required.
nodes.mandatory_action: Make security logs available to law enforcement and regulatory agencies upon request.

nodes.text: Logging shall be enabled to track critical system activities which shall include: User account management, Privileged user activities.
nodes.mandatory_action: Enable logging to track critical system activities including user account management and privileged user activities.

nodes.text: Logging shall be enabled to track critical system activities which shall include: User account management, Privileged user activities, Changes in OS configuration, Multiple authentication failures/sim
nodes.mandatory_action: Enable logging to track critical system activities.

nodes.text: All information systems including application, operating system, database, network and security devices shall maintain time synchronization with a standard time device/ server (NTP) to provide an accu
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure all information systems maintain time synchronization with a standard time device/server.

nodes.text: Log Retention schedule should be compliant with Organization’s record retention policy.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish a log retention schedule compliant with the organization's record retention policy.

nodes.text: All the logs and logging facilities should be protected against tampering and unauthorized access.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement protections for logs and logging facilities against tampering and unauthorized access.

nodes.text: Monitoring reports should be published based on the management requirements.
nodes.mandatory_action: Publish monitoring reports based on management requirements.

nodes.text: Periodic review of logs and monitoring reports for adequacy and contents should be performed.
nodes.mandatory_action: Periodic reviews of logs and monitoring reports must be conducted for adequacy and contents.

nodes.text: Incidents reported should be closed within defined timelines.
nodes.mandatory_action: All reported incidents must be closed within the defined timelines.

nodes.text: Policy, Procedures and Guidelines for information security and cyber security incident management shall be prepared and implemented to discover, record, response, escalate and prevent information secu
nodes.mandatory_action: Prepare and implement policies, procedures, and guidelines for incident management.

nodes.text: There should be a system in place to ensure information security events and weaknesses associated with the information assets are communicated and corrective actions are taken in a timely manner.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish a system for timely communication and corrective action for information security events.

nodes.text: An incident management process shall be established, documented, implemented and maintained by the organization.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish, document, implement, and maintain an incident management process.

nodes.text: Roles and responsibilities of all the stakeholders of the incident management process shall be defined.
nodes.mandatory_action: Define roles and responsibilities for all stakeholders in the incident management process.

nodes.text: Incident management team shall be established to take all incident related decisions.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish an incident management team responsible for incident-related decisions.

nodes.text: A communication channel shall be set up with internal parties and external organizations (e.g., regulator, media, law enforcement, customers).
nodes.mandatory_action: Set up a communication channel for incident management with relevant internal and external parties.

nodes.text: The Information security and Cyber security incident classification criteria shall be documented.
nodes.mandatory_action: Document the incident classification criteria for information security and cyber security incidents.

nodes.text: A process to assess the root cause of the incident and identifying the corrective and preventive measures shall be defined.
nodes.mandatory_action: Define a process to assess the root cause of incidents and identify corrective and preventive measures.

nodes.text: For Incident and Cyber Crisis; a comprehensive cyber security response plan needs to be developed and referred.
nodes.mandatory_action: Develop and refer to a comprehensive cyber security response plan for incidents and cyber crises.

nodes.text: For Incident and Cyber Crisis; a comprehensive cyber crisis management plan (CCMP) needs to be developed and referred.
nodes.mandatory_action: Develop and refer to a comprehensive cyber crisis management plan (CCMP) for incidents and cyber crises.
